## Setup

Models use the original daily dataset, with temporal predictor selection repeated within each outer training fold. Set A includes available field measurements; Set B excludes them.


## GAM temporal selection

```{r selection}
predictor_groups <- list(
  Solar    = c("Solar_daily", "Solar_2d", "Solar_3d", "Solar_7d"),
  WL_mean  = c("WL_daily_mean", "WL_mean_2day", "WL_mean_3day", "WL_mean_7day"),
  WL_max   = c("WL_daily_max", "WL_max_2day", "WL_max_3day", "WL_max_7day"),
  WL_min   = c("WL_daily_min", "WL_min_2day", "WL_min_3day", "WL_min_7day"),
  Air_tmean= c("Air_tmean", "Air_tmean_2day", "Air_tmean_3day", "Air_tmean_7day"),
  Air_tmax = c("Air_tmax", "Air_tmax_2day", "Air_tmax_3day", "Air_tmax_7day"),
  Air_tmin = c("Air_tmin", "Air_tmin_2day", "Air_tmin_3day", "Air_tmin_7day"),
  GWT_mean = c("GWT_mean", "GWT_mean_2day", "GWT_mean_3day", "GWT_mean_7day"),
  GWT_max  = c("GWT_max", "GWT_max_2day", "GWT_max_3day", "GWT_max_7day"),
  GWT_min  = c("GWT_min", "GWT_min_2day", "GWT_min_3day", "GWT_min_7day"),
  GWL_mean = c("GWL_mean", "GWL_mean_2day", "GWL_mean_3day", "GWL_mean_7day"),
  GWL_max  = c("GWL_max", "GWL_max_2day", "GWL_max_3day", "GWL_max_7day"),
  GWL_min  = c("GWL_min", "GWL_min_2day", "GWL_min_3day", "GWL_min_7day"),
  ppt      = c("ppt", "ppt_7day")
)

# Retain site-varying non-temporal predictors; exclude between-site constants
# (Elev_m, Size_km2) from LOCAL models.
static_predictors <- c(
  "Air_trange", "WL_daily_range", "GWT_range", "GWL_range",
  "Water_area_m2_3d"
)

# Local models operate within one site, so within-site WL/GWL z-scoring
# does not change the information in these predictors. Keep original values
# to preserve the local model data scale used by the original script.

make_gam_weekly_folds <- function(data, k = 5, seed = 42) {
  week_id <- lubridate::floor_date(as.Date(data$Datetime),
                                   unit = "week", week_start = 1)
  weeks <- unique(week_id)
  if (length(weeks) < k) {
    stop("Not enough distinct weeks for ", k, "-fold GAM CV (found ",
         length(weeks), ").")
  }
  set.seed(seed)
  weeks <- sample(weeks)
  week_groups <- split(weeks, rep(seq_len(k), length.out = length(weeks)))
  lapply(week_groups, function(w) which(week_id %in% w))
}

select_gam_predictors_site <- function(train_data, response_var,
                                       k_folds = 5, seed = 42) {
  stopifnot(length(unique(stats::na.omit(train_data$Site))) == 1)
  if (!response_var %in% names(train_data)) stop("Missing response: ", response_var)

  purrr::imap_dfr(predictor_groups, function(vars, group_name) {
    existing <- intersect(vars, names(train_data))
    if (!length(existing)) return(tibble::tibble())

    # Remove candidates with no variability or insufficient observations.
    # Complete cases are shared by all remaining candidates for fair comparison.
    repeat {
      common <- train_data %>%
        dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c("Datetime", response_var, existing))) %>%
        tidyr::drop_na()
      if (!length(existing) || nrow(common) < 10) break
      eligible <- vapply(existing, function(v) {
        is.numeric(common[[v]]) &&
          length(unique(common[[v]])) >= 2
      }, logical(1))
      if (all(eligible)) break
      existing <- existing[eligible]
    }
    if (!length(existing) || nrow(common) < 10) {
      warning("Skipping group ", group_name, " for ", response_var,
              ": insufficient complete observations or variation.")
      return(tibble::tibble())
    }
    if (length(unique(lubridate::floor_date(common$Datetime,
                 unit = "week", week_start = 1))) < k_folds) {
      warning("Skipping group ", group_name, " for ", response_var,
              ": fewer than ", k_folds, " distinct weeks.")
      return(tibble::tibble())
    }

    folds <- make_gam_weekly_folds(common, k = k_folds, seed = seed)
    scores <- purrr::map_dfr(existing, function(v) {
      predictions <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(common))
      for (holdout in folds) {
        training <- common[-holdout, , drop = FALSE]
        n_unique <- length(unique(training[[v]]))
        # Use k=5 where possible; otherwise use a linear term.
        form <- if (n_unique >= 5) {
          stats::as.formula(paste0(response_var, " ~ s(`", v, "`, k = 5)"))
        } else {
          stats::reformulate(v, response = response_var)
        }
        fit <- mgcv::gam(form, data = training, method = "REML")
        predictions[holdout] <- as.numeric(stats::predict(
          fit, newdata = common[holdout, , drop = FALSE]
        ))
      }
      tibble::tibble(predictor = v,
                     cv_rmse = sqrt(mean((common[[response_var]] - predictions)^2)))
    })
    scores %>%
      dplyr::arrange(cv_rmse, match(predictor, existing)) %>%
      dplyr::slice(1) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(group = group_name, n = nrow(common), .before = 1)
  })
}

# Helper to use from the local MODELING script inside EACH outer training fold.
# This does not use observations outside the supplied train_data.
select_for_local_site <- function(train_data, response_var, k = 5, seed = 42, mode = "A") {
  # Screen only eligible groups for each predictor set (avoids B screening field variables).
  groups_old <- predictor_groups
  if (mode == "B") {
    eligible_groups <- lapply(predictor_groups, function(x) x[remote_ok(x)])
    eligible_groups <- Filter(length, eligible_groups)
  } else eligible_groups <- predictor_groups
  # Local temporary binding via function environment, without changing global groups.
  selector <- select_gam_predictors_site
  environment(selector) <- list2env(list(predictor_groups=eligible_groups), parent=environment(select_gam_predictors_site))
  selection <- selector(train_data, response_var,
                        k_folds = k, seed = seed)
  statics <- intersect(static_predictors, names(train_data))
  if (mode == "B") statics <- statics[remote_ok(statics)]
  statics <- statics[vapply(statics, function(v) {
    x <- train_data[[v]]
    is.numeric(x) && length(unique(x[is.finite(x)])) >= 2
  }, logical(1))]
  list(predictors = unique(c(selection$predictor, statics)),
       selection = selection)
}
```

## Weekly outer folds and model helpers

```{r helpers}
remote_prefix <- c("WL_", "GWT_", "GWL_", "Water")
remote_ok <- function(p) !vapply(p, function(x) any(startsWith(x, remote_prefix)), logical(1))

make_weekly_folds <- function(df, k = 5, seed = 42) {
  wk <- floor_date(df$Datetime, "week", week_start = 1)
  u <- sort(unique(wk))
  if (length(u) < k) stop("Too few weeks for CV")
  set.seed(seed)
  u <- sample(u)
  groups <- split(u, rep(seq_len(k), length.out = length(u)))
  lapply(groups, function(g) which(wk %in% g))
}

score_oof <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x$obs) & is.finite(x$pred), , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(x) < 3) return(tibble(RMSE=NA_real_, MAE=NA_real_, R2=NA_real_, NSE=NA_real_, n_oof=nrow(x)))
  tibble(RMSE=sqrt(mean((x$obs-x$pred)^2)), MAE=mean(abs(x$obs-x$pred)),
         R2=if (sum((x$obs-mean(x$obs))^2)>0) 1-sum((x$obs-x$pred)^2)/sum((x$obs-mean(x$obs))^2) else NA_real_,
         NSE=if (sum((x$obs-mean(x$obs))^2)>0) 1-sum((x$obs-x$pred)^2)/sum((x$obs-mean(x$obs))^2) else NA_real_, n_oof=nrow(x))
}

vif_prune <- function(dat, response, predictors, limit = 5) {
  keep <- predictors
  removed <- character()
  repeat {
    if (!length(keep)) break
    nonconstant <- vapply(keep, function(v) sd(dat[[v]]) > 0, logical(1))
    if (any(!nonconstant)) {
      removed <- c(removed, keep[!nonconstant]); keep <- keep[nonconstant]
    }
    if (length(keep) <= 1) break
    fit <- lm(reformulate(keep, response), data=dat)
    alias <- intersect(names(coef(fit))[is.na(coef(fit))], keep)
    if (length(alias)) {
      keep <- setdiff(keep, alias); removed <- c(removed, alias); next
    }
    v <- tryCatch(car::vif(fit), error=function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(v)) stop("Could not compute VIF; inspect predictors")
    if (is.matrix(v)) stop("Unexpected GVIF matrix for numeric predictors")
    if (max(v) <= limit) break
    bad <- names(which.max(v))
    removed <- c(removed, bad); keep <- setdiff(keep, bad)
  }
  list(keep=keep, dropped=unique(removed))
}

# 8 XGB candidates vs the original 288-candidate grid; bounded threads and rounds.
xgb_grid <- if (full_tuning) expand.grid(
  nrounds=c(400,800), eta=c(.05,.1), max_depth=c(6,9,12),
  min_child_weight=c(1,4), subsample=c(.8,.9),
  colsample_bytree=c(.8,1), gamma=c(0,.1,1)
) else expand.grid(
  nrounds=c(150,300), eta=c(.05,.1), max_depth=c(3,6),
  min_child_weight=2, subsample=.8, colsample_bytree=.8, gamma=0
)
rf_grid <- function(p) {
  if (full_tuning) {
    m <- unique(pmax(1, pmin(p, c(floor(sqrt(p))-1, floor(sqrt(p)),
                  floor(sqrt(p))+1, floor(p/4), floor(p/3), floor(p/2), ceiling(2*p/3)))))
    nodes <- c(1,2,3,5,7,10,15)
  } else {
    m <- unique(pmax(1, pmin(p, c(floor(sqrt(p)), floor(p/3), floor(p/2)))))
    nodes <- c(3,7)
  }
  expand.grid(mtry=sort(m), splitrule="variance", min.node.size=nodes)
}

fit_ml <- function(tr, va, response, preds, alg, seed=42) {
  tr <- tr[complete.cases(tr[,c("Datetime",response,preds),drop=FALSE]),,drop=FALSE]
  va <- va[complete.cases(va[,c("Datetime",response,preds),drop=FALSE]),,drop=FALSE]
  if (nrow(tr)<30 || !nrow(va) || !length(preds)) stop("Insufficient model data")
  inner <- make_weekly_folds(tr, k=5, seed=seed)
  idx_out <- inner
  idx <- lapply(inner, function(i) setdiff(seq_len(nrow(tr)), i))
  ctrl <- caret::trainControl(method="cv", number=5, index=idx, indexOut=idx_out,
                              allowParallel=FALSE, savePredictions="none")
  grid <- if (alg=="rfr") rf_grid(length(preds)) else xgb_grid
  args <- list(x=tr[,preds,drop=FALSE], y=tr[[response]],
               method=if (alg=="rfr") "ranger" else "xgbTree",
               trControl=ctrl, tuneGrid=grid, metric="RMSE")
  if (alg=="rfr") {
    args <- c(args,list(num.trees=500, num.threads=1, importance="permutation"))
  } else args <- c(args,list(nthread=1, verbose=0))
  set.seed(seed)
  fit <- do.call(caret::train, args)
  oof <- tibble(Site=va$Site, Date=va$Datetime, obs=va[[response]],
                pred=as.numeric(predict(fit,newdata=va[,preds,drop=FALSE])))
  list(fit=fit, oof=oof)
}

fit_gls <- function(tr, va, response, preds) {
  tr <- tr[complete.cases(tr[,c("Datetime",response,preds),drop=FALSE]),,drop=FALSE]
  if (nrow(tr)<30) stop("Insufficient GLS data")
  vp <- vif_prune(tr, response, preds, limit=5)
  kept <- vp$keep
  form <- reformulate(kept, response=response)
  tr <- tr[order(tr$Datetime),,drop=FALSE]
  tr$.day_index <- as.integer(tr$Datetime - min(tr$Datetime))
  fit <- nlme::gls(form, data=tr, method="REML",
                   correlation=nlme::corAR1(form=~.day_index),
                   control=nlme::glsControl(msMaxIter=200))
  va <- va[complete.cases(va[,c("Datetime",response,kept),drop=FALSE]),,drop=FALSE]
  va$.day_index <- as.integer(va$Datetime - min(tr$Datetime))
  oof <- tibble(Site=va$Site, Date=va$Datetime, obs=va[[response]],
                pred=as.numeric(predict(fit,newdata=va)))
  list(fit=fit, oof=oof, kept=kept, dropped=vp$dropped)
}
```

## Model fitting

**Important:** Each outer test fold is completely excluded from GAM selection, VIF filtering, model tuning, and model fitting. GAM screening within the outer training data uses its own five weekly folds. Inner caret folds tune ML hyperparameters; as in the revised global workflow, GAM selection is *not* repeated within every inner tuning fold. Missing values are left untouched in the raw data and excluded only where needed for a particular fit/prediction.

```{r run_models}
raw <- read.csv(data_path, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
raw$Datetime <- as.Date(raw$Datetime, tryFormats=c("%m/%d/%Y","%Y-%m-%d"))
stopifnot(!anyNA(raw$Datetime), all(c("Site","mean_WT","max_WT","range_WT") %in% names(raw)))
raw <- raw[order(raw$Site,raw$Datetime),,drop=FALSE]
if (!is.null(test_site)) raw <- raw[raw$Site==test_site,,drop=FALSE]

run_one <- function(dat, response, site, metric) {
  dat <- dat[!is.na(dat[[response]]),,drop=FALSE]
  folds <- make_weekly_folds(dat, k=5)
  fold_records <- list(); selection_log <- list(); vif_log <- list()
  algorithms <- c("rfr","xgb","gls")
  modes <- c("A","B")
  for (j in seq_along(folds)) {
    tr <- dat[-folds[[j]],,drop=FALSE]
    va <- dat[folds[[j]],,drop=FALSE]
    for (mode in modes) {
      selected <- select_for_local_site(tr,response,k=5,mode=mode)
      preds <- selected$predictors
      if (!length(preds)) next
      sl <- selected$selection
      selection_log[[length(selection_log)+1L]] <- mutate(sl,Site=site,Metric=metric,Set=mode,fold=j,.before=1)
      for (alg in algorithms) {
        key <- paste(site,metric,mode,alg,sep="_")
        message("  ",key," | outer fold ",j,"/5")
        res <- if (alg=="gls") fit_gls(tr,va,response,preds) else fit_ml(tr,va,response,preds,alg)
        res$oof$fold <- j
        fold_records[[key]][[j]] <- res$oof
        if (alg=="gls") vif_log[[length(vif_log)+1L]] <- tibble(Site=site,Metric=metric,Set=mode,fold=j,
             kept=paste(res$kept,collapse="; "), dropped=paste(res$dropped,collapse="; "))
        rm(res); gc(verbose=FALSE)
      }
    }
  }
  # Final full-data selection and fits, separately for each predictor set.
  final <- list(); summary <- list()
  for (mode in modes) {
    chosen <- select_for_local_site(dat,response,k=5,mode=mode)
    preds <- chosen$predictors
    if (!length(preds)) next
    for (alg in algorithms) {
      key <- paste(site,metric,mode,alg,sep="_")
      oof <- dplyr::bind_rows(fold_records[[key]])
      if (alg=="gls") {
        # Full-data GLS: no test set required; reuse training data as placeholder.
        res <- fit_gls(dat,dat,response,preds)
        fit <- res$fit; final_preds <- res$kept
      } else {
        res <- fit_ml(dat,dat,response,preds,alg)
        fit <- res$fit; final_preds <- preds
      }
      final[[key]] <- list(response=response, model_type=alg,
         predictors=final_preds, predictors_init=preds,
         best_params=if(alg=="gls") NULL else fit$bestTune,
         fit_object=fit, oof_predictions=oof, metrics_overall=score_oof(oof),
         selection_full=chosen$selection,
         var_importance=if(alg=="gls") NULL else tryCatch(caret::varImp(fit)$importance,error=function(e) NULL))
      summary[[key]] <- mutate(score_oof(oof), Site=site,Metric=metric,Set=mode,Model=toupper(alg),
                               n_predictors=length(final_preds),.before=1)
      rm(res,fit); gc(verbose=FALSE)
    }
  }
  list(models=final, summary=dplyr::bind_rows(summary),
       selections=dplyr::bind_rows(selection_log),vif=dplyr::bind_rows(vif_log))
}

sites <- sort(unique(raw$Site))
if (run_models) for (site in sites) {
  for (metric in c("max","mean","range")) {
    response <- paste0(metric,"_WT")
    message("=== ",site," / ",metric," ===")
    checkpoint <- file.path(ml_dir,paste0(site,"_",metric,"_metrics_revised.csv"))
    if (resume_completed && file.exists(checkpoint)) {
      message("Skipping completed: ",site," / ",metric); next
    }
    out <- run_one(raw[raw$Site==site,,drop=FALSE],response,site,metric)
    # A checkpoint per site/response avoids losing completed work if interrupted.
    is_gls <- grepl("_gls$", names(out$models))
    saveRDS(out$models[!is_gls],file.path(ml_dir,paste0(site,"_",metric,"_ml_models_revised.rds")))
    saveRDS(out$models[is_gls],file.path(gls_dir,paste0(site,"_",metric,"_gls_models_revised.rds")))
    readr::write_csv(out$selections,file.path(ml_dir,paste0(site,"_",metric,"_gam_folds_revised.csv")))
    readr::write_csv(out$vif,file.path(gls_dir,paste0(site,"_",metric,"_vif_revised.csv")))
    readr::write_csv(out$summary,file.path(ml_dir,paste0(site,"_",metric,"_metrics_revised.csv")))
    rm(out); gc(verbose=FALSE)
  }
}
```

## Model diagnostics and coefficients

```{r diagnostics}
model_paths <- c(list.files(ml_dir, "_ml_models_revised\\.rds$", full.names=TRUE),
                 list.files(gls_dir, "_gls_models_revised\\.rds$", full.names=TRUE))
collect_final <- function(fn) {
  fits <- readRDS(fn)
  out <- purrr::imap_dfr(fits, function(x, key) {
    parts <- strsplit(key, "_", fixed=TRUE)[[1]]
    bp <- if (!is.null(x$best_params)) as.list(x$best_params[1,,drop=FALSE]) else list()
    tibble::tibble(Site=parts[1], Metric=parts[2], Set=parts[3], Model=toupper(parts[4]),
                   n_predictors=length(x$predictors), predictors=paste(x$predictors,collapse="; "),
                   best_params=paste(paste(names(bp),unlist(bp),sep="="),collapse="; "),
                   n_oof=nrow(x$oof_predictions),
                   max_abs_error=if(nrow(x$oof_predictions)) max(abs(x$oof_predictions$obs-x$oof_predictions$pred),na.rm=TRUE) else NA_real_)
  })
  rm(fits); gc(verbose=FALSE); out
}
final_diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(model_paths,collect_final))
readr::write_csv(final_diagnostics,file.path(ml_dir,"local_final_model_diagnostics_revised.csv"))

coef_rows <- list(); phi_rows <- list(); internal_rows <- list(); oof_rows <- list()
for (fn in model_paths) {
  models <- readRDS(fn)
  for (key in names(models)) {
    x <- models[[key]]; parts <- strsplit(key,"_",fixed=TRUE)[[1]]
    info <- tibble::tibble(Site=parts[1],Metric=parts[2],Set=parts[3],Model=toupper(parts[4]))
    oof_rows[[length(oof_rows)+1L]] <- dplyr::bind_cols(info[rep(1,nrow(x$oof_predictions)),,drop=FALSE],dplyr::select(x$oof_predictions,-dplyr::any_of(c("Site","Metric","Set","Model"))))
    if (parts[4]=="gls") {
      tt <- summary(x$fit_object)$tTable
      coef_rows[[length(coef_rows)+1L]] <- dplyr::bind_cols(info[rep(1,nrow(tt)),,drop=FALSE],
          tibble::tibble(predictor=rownames(tt),estimate=tt[,"Value"],SE=tt[,"Std.Error"],
                         t_value=tt[,"t-value"],p_value=tt[,"p-value"]))
      phi <- tryCatch(as.numeric(coef(x$fit_object$modelStruct$corStruct,unconstrained=FALSE)),error=function(e) NA_real_)
      phi_rows[[length(phi_rows)+1L]] <- dplyr::mutate(info,phi=phi)
    } else if (!is.null(x$var_importance)) {
      imp <- x$var_importance
      internal_rows[[length(internal_rows)+1L]] <- dplyr::bind_cols(info[rep(1,nrow(imp)),,drop=FALSE],
         tibble::tibble(Variable=rownames(imp),Importance=as.numeric(imp[[1]])))
    }
  }
  rm(models); gc(verbose=FALSE)
}
readr::write_csv(dplyr::bind_rows(coef_rows),file.path(gls_dir,"gls_coefficients_local_revised.csv"))
readr::write_csv(dplyr::bind_rows(phi_rows),file.path(gls_dir,"gls_ar1_phi_local_revised.csv"))
readr::write_csv(dplyr::bind_rows(internal_rows),file.path(ml_dir,"varimp_internal_local_revised.csv"))
all_oof <- dplyr::bind_rows(oof_rows)
readr::write_csv(all_oof,file.path(ml_dir,"local_oof_predictions_revised.csv"))
vif_files <- list.files(gls_dir,"_vif_revised\\.csv$",full.names=TRUE)
readr::write_csv(dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(vif_files,readr::read_csv,show_col_types=FALSE)),
                 file.path(gls_dir,"gls_vif_log_local_revised.csv"))
```

## Common-date out-of-fold performance

Compare RFR, XGB, and GLS on matched observation dates without refitting.

```{r comparable_oof_metrics}
# `all_oof` is created in the diagnostics chunk above.
stopifnot(exists("all_oof"), all(c("Site","Metric","Set","Model","Date","obs","pred") %in% names(all_oof)))
valid_oof <- all_oof |>
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(obs), is.finite(pred)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Date=as.Date(Date))

# Check that each model predicts each date at most once.
duplicates <- valid_oof |>
  dplyr::count(Site,Metric,Set,Model,Date) |>
  dplyr::filter(n > 1)
if (nrow(duplicates)) stop("Duplicate site/metric/set/model/date OOF predictions; inspect before scoring.")

# A comparable date must have predictions from ALL three algorithms.
common_dates <- valid_oof |>
  dplyr::group_by(Site,Metric,Set,Date) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n_models=dplyr::n_distinct(Model),.groups="drop") |>
  dplyr::filter(n_models == 3L) |>
  dplyr::select(Site,Metric,Set,Date)

common_oof <- valid_oof |>
  dplyr::inner_join(common_dates,by=c("Site","Metric","Set","Date"))

# Verify that the observed value is identical for every model on each date.
obs_disagreement <- common_oof |>
  dplyr::group_by(Site,Metric,Set,Date) |>
  dplyr::summarise(obs_span=max(obs)-min(obs),.groups="drop") |>
  dplyr::filter(obs_span > 1e-8)
if (nrow(obs_disagreement)) stop("Observed WT differs across models on the same date.")

score_predictive <- function(d) {
  n <- nrow(d)
  if (n < 3L) return(tibble::tibble(RMSE=NA_real_,MAE=NA_real_,R2=NA_real_,NSE=NA_real_,n_oof=n))
  sse <- sum((d$obs-d$pred)^2)
  sst <- sum((d$obs-mean(d$obs))^2)
  r2 <- if (sst > 0) 1-sse/sst else NA_real_
  tibble::tibble(RMSE=sqrt(mean((d$obs-d$pred)^2)),
                 MAE=mean(abs(d$obs-d$pred)),R2=r2,NSE=r2,n_oof=n)
}

common_metrics <- common_oof |>
  dplyr::group_by(Site,Metric,Set,Model) |>
  dplyr::group_modify(~score_predictive(.x)) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Original prediction counts make the effects of common-date filtering transparent.
original_counts <- valid_oof |>
  dplyr::count(Site,Metric,Set,Model,name="n_oof_original")
common_metrics <- common_metrics |>
  dplyr::left_join(original_counts,by=c("Site","Metric","Set","Model")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(n_excluded=n_oof_original-n_oof) |>
  dplyr::arrange(Site,Metric,Set,Model)

readr::write_csv(common_metrics,file.path(ml_dir,"local_models_summary_common_dates_revised.csv"))
readr::write_csv(common_oof,file.path(ml_dir,"local_oof_common_dates_revised.csv"))
```


## Permutation importance

Importance is calculated on final-model training data as the increase in RMSE.

```{r permutation_importance}
if (run_importance) {
  imp_dir <- file.path(ml_dir,"importance_revised")
  dir.create(imp_dir,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
  for (fn in model_paths) {
    models <- readRDS(fn)
    for (key in names(models)) {
      dest <- file.path(imp_dir,paste0(key,"_permutation_revised.csv"))
      if (resume_completed && file.exists(dest)) next
      x <- models[[key]]; parts <- strsplit(key,"_",fixed=TRUE)[[1]]
      dat <- raw[raw$Site==parts[1],,drop=FALSE]
      pred_names <- x$predictors
      dat <- dat[stats::complete.cases(dat[,c(x$response,pred_names),drop=FALSE]),,drop=FALSE]
      if (!nrow(dat)) next
      # Predictors and response are numeric; iml accepts a custom predict function.
      pf <- function(model,newdata) as.numeric(stats::predict(model,newdata=newdata))
      predictor <- iml::Predictor$new(model=x$fit_object,data=dat[,pred_names,drop=FALSE],
                                      y=dat[[x$response]],predict.function=pf)
      set.seed(42)
      imp <- iml::FeatureImp$new(predictor,loss="rmse",compare="difference",
                                 n.repetitions=importance_repetitions)
      tab <- as.data.frame(imp$results)
      names(tab)[names(tab)=="feature"] <- "Variable"
      names(tab)[names(tab)=="importance"] <- "Importance"
      tab <- dplyr::mutate(tab,Site=parts[1],Metric=parts[2],Set=parts[3],
                            Model=toupper(parts[4]),.before=1)
      readr::write_csv(tab,dest)
      rm(imp,predictor); gc(verbose=FALSE)
    }
    rm(models); gc(verbose=FALSE)
  }
}
imp_dir <- file.path(ml_dir,"importance_revised")
imp_files <- if (dir.exists(imp_dir)) list.files(imp_dir,"_permutation_revised\\.csv$",full.names=TRUE) else character()
if (length(imp_files)) {
  permutation_vi <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(imp_files,readr::read_csv,show_col_types=FALSE))
  readr::write_csv(permutation_vi,file.path(ml_dir,"varimp_permutation_local_ALL_revised.csv"))
}
```


## Observed versus predicted — Set A

```{r oof_plots}

resp_lab <- c(max = "Max WT", mean = "Mean WT", range = "Range WT")

out_dir <- file.path(fig_dir, "obs_pred_local")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Use revised Set A outer-fold predictions
dd <- all_oof |>
  dplyr::filter(
    Set == "A",
    is.finite(obs),
    is.finite(pred)
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Model = factor(Model, levels = c("GLS", "RFR", "XGB")),
    Site = factor(Site, levels = sort(unique(as.character(Site))))
  )

for (metric in c("max", "mean", "range")) {

  plot_df <- dd |>
    dplyr::filter(Metric == metric)

  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) next

  # Common axis limits for all panels
  lims <- c(
    floor(min(c(plot_df$obs, plot_df$pred))),
    ceiling(max(c(plot_df$obs, plot_df$pred)))
  )

  # Integer tick marks, similar to original
  step <- max(1, round(diff(lims) / 7))
  breaks <- seq(lims[1], lims[2], by = step)

  # Calculate slope and RMSE from revised OOF predictions
  annotations <- plot_df |>
    dplyr::group_by(Site, Model) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      slope = if (dplyr::n_distinct(obs) > 1) {
        unname(coef(stats::lm(pred ~ obs))[2])
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      RMSE = sqrt(mean((pred - obs)^2)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      label = sprintf("slope=%.2f\nRMSE=%.2f", slope, RMSE),
      x = lims[1] + 0.03 * diff(lims),
      y = lims[2] - 0.05 * diff(lims)
    )

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    plot_df,
    ggplot2::aes(x = obs, y = pred)
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      alpha = 0.65,
      size = 1.3
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_abline(
      slope = 1,
      intercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.7
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_smooth(
      method = "lm",
      se = FALSE,
      color = "red",
      linewidth = 0.9
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(
      data = annotations,
      ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 3
    ) +
    ggplot2::facet_grid(Model ~ Site) +
    ggplot2::coord_equal(
      xlim = lims,
      ylim = lims,
      expand = FALSE
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = breaks,
      minor_breaks = NULL
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = breaks,
      minor_breaks = NULL
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = resp_lab[[metric]],
      x = "Observed (°C)",
      y = "Predicted (°C)"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_line(linewidth = 0.35),
      strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.spacing = grid::unit(6, "pt"),
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 15),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = grid::unit(c(5, 6, 5, 6), "pt")
    )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      out_dir,
      paste0("local_", metric, "_obs_vs_pred_revised.png")
    ),
    plot = p,
    width = 12,
    height = 8.5,
    units = "in",
    dpi = 300,
    bg = "white"
  )

  print(p)
}
```

## Running the analysis

For a single-site test, set `test_site <- "Anvil"` and `run_importance <- FALSE`. Use `test_site <- NULL` for all sites. Saved checkpoints can be used to rebuild summaries and figures with `run_models <- FALSE`.

Temporal selection is repeated within outer training folds, but not within caret tuning folds. Use outer-fold performance for evaluation.
